Get the AI on your phone
Open Engine: the small model dot at the top of a page, or Engine at the bottom of the sidebar.
Attune picks the best model for this phone. Tap Download — once, on Wi-Fi.
When it says Ready, everything works with no internet, and nothing you type leaves the phone.
Bigger is smarter but warmer: Spark and Glow are light, Core is the everyday choice, Zenith wants 12 GB of memory or more.
Find your way: the sidebar
Tap ☰ at the top to open the sidebar (on a computer it is always on the left). It has 8 places: Create · Projects · Home · Students · Money · Health · Daily · Work.
Each place is one page with tabs on top. Money = Money · Follow-ups · Deal Check. Work = Business · Team records · Reports · Tools.
At the very bottom: How to use Attune, Privacy, Engine, Backup and Settings. Back always takes you to the page before.
Every guide here ends with Open it — it takes you straight to that tool.
Just say it on Home
Type or say what happened in the Home box: “had foul and 2 eggs”, “spent 150 on lunch”, “took my insulin”.
Attune puts it in the right place — Fit & Food, Money, Family health, Reminders, People & plans, Dates — and says what it did. Wrong? Tap Undo.
Under the box: three quick starts (Food photo, A file, Find for me), “Attune suggests” with what is waiting today, and four tiles with one number each.
One sentence can do two things: “koshary for lunch, 80 pounds” goes to Fit & Food AND Money.
Ask anything in Chat
Home → Chat. Type, or hold the microphone and speak — Arabic or English.
+ adds photos or files: Attune reads them and answers about them.
Leave it on Auto: it picks the model, the web and thinking for each question. Deep answer is for a big question.
Say what you want done, not just the topic: “compare these two cars for a family of five” beats “cars”.
Type with the Attune keyboard
Settings → Attune keyboard → Turn on, then Switch to it. It works in WhatsApp, Gmail — every app.
Above the keys: Improve, Translate, Reply and Prompt — done by the model on your phone, offline.
Tap the Franco chip again to type plain English.
Keep it safe: backup

en: Everything is kept on this phone only. Backup (bottom of the sidebar) saves all of it in one file.
New phone? Open that file there and all your data comes back.
Your Profile (name, country, language) makes every answer fit you.
Make it a habit: one backup every Friday, saved somewhere off the phone.
The box that does it all, quick starts and what is waiting today
Ask anything — with photos, files and the web
Spending, bills, Zakāt — and what is safe to spend today
Food, medicines and cycle on one page
Prompts, compress, humanize, copilot, library, video
What stays on your phone — and locking places with your fingerprint
Machine health from your team's site reports
Incident and maintenance reports from what you say
Type or say anything in the box — “remind me at 5 to call mum”, “spent 200 on petrol”, “find me a used Corolla”.
“Attune suggests” lists what is waiting today: a bill, a dose, a trial that ends. Tick Paid or Done right there.
The four tiles (Money, Health, Daily, Work) show one number each — tap one to open it.
Start every morning here — it is your day on one screen.
Type or hold the microphone and speak; + adds photos and files.
Auto picks the model, the web and thinking for you; Deep answer reads many pages for a big question.
Ask about your own things (“what did I spend on food this month?”) and the answer comes from your data.
👎 on a wrong answer and say why — Attune remembers the fix.
Ask in your own words: “who owes me money?”, “is mum's sugar better?”, “what's due this week?”.
Attune finds the answer in your own records — Money, People & plans, Family health, Fit & Food, Dates, Mind — and does the sums by code.
Tap Open to see where each number came from.
Ask how something changed — “food spending since Ramadan”, “my spending by month” — and you get a chart, every number from your own records.
Type text, open a PDF or Word file, or take a photo of a sign or a menu.
Pick the language — any language.
Every part is checked, and the document keeps its layout.
Conversation: two people, one phone — each taps their side and speaks; the other reads it and hears it.
Share text or a photo to Attune from any app — or paste it here.
Pick an action: summarise, reply, translate, find the address, add to the calendar.
The result is ready to copy or send back.
Pull down the quick settings and add the “Attune Instant” tile: one tap opens Instant over any app.
Make a book for a subject — work, recipes, a course.
Add notes and pages to it; they stay in order.
Review: your notes come back on the day you are about to forget them — tap Forgot, Hard or I remembered.
Export a book as a document or share it. Five minutes of Review a day and what you read stays with you.
Check the line it shows, and tap Turn it on. It needs Notification access (the same switch Money uses).
When your bank's notification comes, you get Attune's notification at once; the money goes into the pot when Attune opens.
It runs on the phone with no AI and never reads your messages app.
Tap Add screenshots once to bring old ones in, and switch on Keep my notifications (30 days, never SMS).
Everything stays on the phone — turning notifications off forgets them.
Every time Attune opens it reads your Money, your Fit weights and Scout's market book, and shows your real chance (from your own past days, thousands of possible futures) and your progress.
You get ONE step for today — “spend 2,925 less a month on food → 68%”, or move the date when it is out of reach. Why shows the proof.
Before a big decision — cash or installments, a new flat, a second car — open “Test a big decision”: 2,000 futures from your own money, with stress tests.
Pick a ready expert or make your own with instructions.
Chat with it — it follows those instructions every time.
Add files it should always know.
Tap 👎 on a wrong answer in an assistant's chat and write the right one — the assistant keeps it as a rule. Share an assistant as one file.
A skill is a saved recipe for the AI: the steps it follows for one kind of job.
Create one, import one, or pick from the list.
Use it from Chat — and share it with friends.
Skills make a small model act like a bigger one on that job.
Pages, documents and small programs Chat makes are kept here.
Open one to use it, change it or share it.
Ask Chat to change it and a new version is saved.
Ask Chat for “a page that tracks…” — what you type into it is kept, and Home screen puts it on your phone like an app.
Describe a picture — in any language.
A quick draft shows first, then the clear picture.
Keep it, draw again, or change a photo with one instruction.
Remove people or things from any photo: tap Erase, paint over them with your finger, Remove — about a second, no internet.
Say what the program should do.
Attune talks it through step by step, writes it and tests it on your phone.
Run it, change it, or keep it in Artifacts.
Python runs right on the phone — try “split this bill between 4 people”.
Make a project for one piece of work.
Put its chats, files and instructions together.
Every chat inside it already knows the files.
The Project brain collects what you decided, what is still open and the dates coming up from the project's chats — and the assistant keeps to it.
Take a photo of the homework question.
The coach solves it by code and teaches it step by step — with pictures and a voice, not just the answer.
Answer the check questions to be sure it is understood.
Mark the worksheet: snap the child's page and every answer is checked — right, wrong with the steps, or not answered.
Open a file: PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel or a photo.
Pick what you want: PDF → Word, photos → PDF, Edit a PDF (change a line, sign, reorder pages)… 80+ choices.
Save or share the new file. It never leaves the phone.
PDF → Word keeps tables and columns; a photo of a printed English page keeps its tables too, read on the phone.
Tap + Books and pick the books you trust (PDF, Word, e-book) — several at once.
Ask anything: it reads every book on the phone and compares them.
Each fact shows its book and page — tap it to see the book's own words; ask follow-ups in the same chat.
The books stay on your phone. A scanned book (pictures of pages) is read with the AI in Ask a PDF first.
Open a PDF or a book.
Ask about it in your own words.
Every answer shows the page it came from — tap to jump there.
Write one sentence: “a 10-slide pitch for my bakery”.
Attune designs the slides or a full report.
Change any slide, then save as PowerPoint or PDF.
Brand kit: your company name, colour and logo go on every deck and report, inside the PowerPoint too.
Answer the questions or paste your old CV.
Paste a job ad — the CV is tailored to it.
Export a clean PDF in English or Arabic.
Job ready → Mock interview: 5 questions out loud, a score for each answer and a better version of it.
“Safe to spend today” on top: what you can spend today and still pay every bill, People & plans payment, trial and debt due before your next salary.
Tap it to see what it counted, and the “Keep aside” amount for what is coming.
Add spending by typing “lunch 150” (or let payment notifications add it); see where it goes, budgets, bills and Zakāt.
Add your salary as a repeating income — then the number counts right up to payday.
Money → Follow-ups → Reminders. Say or type it: “remind me tomorrow at 9 to call Hassan”.
Check the time and the repeat Attune understood, then save.
The phone tells you even when Attune is closed.
Money → Follow-ups → Timeline: every reminder, date, payment, bill, debt and chat promise coming up, by day.
Each one says what slips if you skip it — a trial that starts charging, a payment that goes late.
Tap one to open the page it belongs to and deal with it.
Look at it every Sunday for a minute: the week ahead, and anything late in red.
Money → Follow-ups → Dates. Scan a receipt, paste a trial email, or add a passport or a warranty by hand.
Attune finds the date that matters (trial end, return window, expiry) and warns you before it.
Not using it? Open “Cancel kit” on a trial or renewal: the exact steps (Google Play, App Store or the service's page) and a ready message to copy.
Free trials in your notifications are added by themselves — cancel the day before, not the day after.
Money → Follow-ups → People & plans. Add a person, then what is between you: “Ahmed owes me 12,000”, installments, a gam'eya, the maid every Saturday.
Tick it when it is paid; Attune reminds you of the next one.
Type it the way you would say it — Attune fills in the plan.
In WhatsApp open a group → ⋮ → More → Export chat → Include media → Attune (or pick the exported file here).

Attune reads the messages and looks at every photo on the phone, then sorts them into albums: rooms and things for design, topics by month for news, themes for Hadith — each Hadith as a card with its narrator and source.
Money and promises in a business chat: open the group → “Money & promises in this chat”.
Money → Follow-ups → Chat X-Ray. Export a WhatsApp chat (⋮ → More → Export chat) and open it here.
X-Ray finds the money, promises, dates and questions nobody answered — send what matters to Reminders, People & plans or Money.
“Who keeps their word”: a promise score per person over every chat you X-rayed — kept, broken, late, still open.
It reads Egyptian Arabic the way people really write it.
Money → Follow-ups → Payments. Turn on payment reading (Android asks once) — or paste a statement.
It checks every payment: double charges, price rises, forgotten subscriptions, paying twice for the same thing.
Tap a finding for the proof and what to do — cancel, dispute or keep.
Works with InstaPay, bank and card messages, in any currency.
Money → Month plan: your income split into fixed, savings, everyday and free.
Add a goal — travel by June, a car, Eid — or start the emergency fund; Attune works out this month's share.
Put money in each month; Safe to spend keeps it apart.
Follow-ups → Family: write your name once.
Add to the shopping list, what you paid for the house, and reminders for your parents — or say it in the Home box: «add milk to the family list».
Pick a family code and Send to the family; on their phone: Family → Open a family file. Attune works out who owes whom.
Only the list, the house money and the reminders travel — your Money, Mind and chats never do.
Paste the offer, contract or chat — or take a photo of it.
Deal Check lists the risks, hidden costs, the market price and scam signs.
“In today's money”: installments vs cash at your bank's yearly certificate rate (set it once) — it says which is really cheaper.
Before a phone or a fridge on installments, check here: “0% interest” is not always cheaper.
Health opens on today: calories, the next dose, blood sugar and the cycle on one page.
Tap a card to open its tool: Fit & Food, Family health or Cycle.
Everything you log on Home lands here too.
Lock Health with your fingerprint in Privacy if you share the phone.
Tap + on a meal: type “2 eggs and foul”, say it, scan a barcode, or take a photo of the plate — every food on it is found.
Check the amounts Attune read — change any food or grams.
Your day fills: calories, protein, carbs, fat and fibre against your goal.
If you use insulin (Family health), each meal also shows its carbs and you are warned when your sugar is low.
Photograph the prescription (or type it). Each medicine is read line by line — check it and save.
Reminders are set for every dose; tick each one on Today when it is taken.
Add how many are left (insulin: units) and you are told before they run out.
Insulin users: save your blood sugar on Today — a low reading shows what to do and reminds you to check again in 15 minutes.
Log the first day of each period.
Attune predicts the next one and your fertile days from your own history.
Add symptoms or notes to any day.
A watch that measures night temperature makes it more exact — tap Use my watch's temperature. It stays on this phone.
Pick a topic or a ready course you want to learn.
Every day a short lesson arrives, with a quiz and Say it to practise out loud.
Wrong answers come back on later days until they stick.
Five minutes every morning beats an hour once a week.
Write one sentence: “tell me when hotels near the Haram are under 45k for 4 nights from 10 December”, “tell me when my Amazon order arrives”, “order my usual from Talabat”, or “open Uber”.
If something is missing (the day, the number of nights, your usual dish) the agent asks once. Then it runs: a price is checked about twice a day, even with Attune closed.
Each agent is one card: the last check, what it found, Check now, Pause or Delete. Scout and your message alerts are here too.
Agents never pay: Talabat opens with your order copied, Booking opens on the cheapest offer — you choose and pay.
Say once what you want: “3-bedroom flat for rent in Maadi under 15,000, not ground floor”, a car, a phone, gold, a job.
Scout searches the sites that matter and checks every wish against each ad — ✓, ✗ or “not stated” — with a fair-price meter and a scam check.
Each ad has a “wait or buy” line from the market book: how long ads of this search stay up and how often prices drop.
👍 / 👎 teach it your taste; Follow an ad and you are told when its price drops or it is sold.
Keep anything: a note, a photo of a paper, a voice note, an answer from Chat.
Mind files it by itself on a picture wall — people, dates, money, promises, #tags.
Search it later in your own words; Chat can use it too.
Mind brings things back by itself: type or share a message from someone you have records about and you see what they promised and owe.
Attune links everything about each one — payments, debts, notes, messages — and Chat answers from it: “how much did I pay my barber?”.
Two with the same name? Attune asks which one, and remembers your answer.
«Who is this?» shows names Money and your notes met — one tap makes the card.
Daily → Remember (or Remember on Home). Add a book or file (PDF, Word, EPUB…), a web page — the news — or paste text.
Attune keeps it on this phone and finds its chapters by itself.
Put the book's name in the question when you have saved several: “in The Bakery on Shubra Street, chapter 2”.
Pick the topics you follow.
Every morning Attune gathers them and sums them up.
Tap a story for the full article and its source.
Story threads follow one story over the days — tap What changed for the news since the day before.
Search a place, a compound or an address — or ask “a pharmacy open now near me”.
Tap it for directions — they work offline.
Download a country for the road, or let it load free online.
Ask the map from Chat too: “how far is Alexandria?”.
Type where you are and where you're going — English, Arabic or a square like Tahrir or Ramses.
Attune shows the line, the direction to ride (the last station on the sign), the stops and where to change.
It also gives the minutes and the ticket price — all offline.
No typing? Open a line and tap the stations.
Pick the country you are going to.
Add your dates: Attune checks your passport and the entry rules for your nationality.
Use Arrive, Say it and Ask there — all offline.
The Trip pack shows what is ready: download the map in one tap and turn on the delay & claim watch.
